items.quote: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar
items.claim: Aaron's sons brought blood to him; he dipped his finger in it and applied it to the altar horns, then poured the remainder at the altar base
items.place: altar, horns of the altar, bottom of the altar

items.quote: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses
items.claim: The fat, kidneys, and caul above the liver from the sin offering were burned on the altar in accordance with the LORD's command to Moses
items.object: fat, kidneys, caul above the liver of the sin offering
